fomod.Name: Blackshield Codex
fomod.Author: synthalorian
fomod.Description: Optional links between Blackshield Company, Bounties of Oblivion, Contract Hunter, Steel Oath and Ember Smithing: kept oaths earn company renown, Daedric favor sweetens bounties, and the forge can heat-temper and engrave Blackshield gear. Requires all five. Base game only, no SKSE. Early beta.
